_metadata.description: Requirements derived from the P1 operational targets: supervision reconcile, reading history, actuation efficacy, coverage drift, and the operator board.

requirements.description: Report the two-direction diff between the autoheal check registry and the derived should-be-supervised set: ghost checks on one side, unsupervised plant on the other. The set is computed at read time from the core-set closure and load-bearing declarations, never held as an enumerated roster, and never falls back to a cached list when the closure source is unavailable.
requirements.title: Supervision reconcile

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:IFM-P1-001] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Persist readings and trust verdicts but never band verdicts, so in-band status is recomputed against the current deadband at query time and tightening a target re-grades its own history. The retention floor is derived from the longest declared window rather than hardcoded, so a widened target widens retention with it.
requirements.title: Reading history and band recomputation

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:IFM-P1-002] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Re-read a finding's named sensor after its downstream work lands and record whether the reading returned in band. A fix that does not move its sensor re-opens the finding; a sensor that became untrusted or unavailable in the meantime is reported as unmeasurable and routed to the instrument, never recorded as a pass.
requirements.title: Actuation efficacy

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:IFM-P1-003] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Diff every cell against the fleet's live command surface and report cells whose named sensor no longer resolves, plus MISSING cells whose gap a shipped verb could already close. Both are computed against the live surface rather than a checked-in list.
requirements.title: Coverage drift detection

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:IFM-P1-004] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: A polished read-only operator panel presenting the cell grid, the ranked error surface, the trust distribution, and per-cell drilldown to the evidence behind each verdict. Instrument-panel dense rather than dashboard-decorative, WCAG 2.1 AA with status never carried by colour alone, and shipped vertical-by-vertical with the domain it presents.
requirements.title: Operator board
